description: This Java class 'FlushModeHandler' manages the flush mode of an EntityManager within a specified scope, allowing to temporarily set a different flush mode during execution of a Runnable and restoring the original mode afterward.

classes.name: FlushModeHandler
classes.description: A Spring-managed component that facilitates temporary changes to the flush mode of an EntityManager.

methods.name: withFlushMode
methods.description: Sets a specified flush mode on the EntityManager, executes the provided Runnable, and then restores the original flush mode.
